title: Clean and Noisy DCP IQP / Polynomial-Phase Readout: Directional-Derivative Structure, Carry-Polynomial Degree 2^{t-1}, and Sparse-Row Advantage Bounds

theorems.statement: For any Boolean polynomial P : F_2^K -> F_2 of degree <= d and non-zero mask u in {0,1}^K \ {0}, O_{P, u} = D_P X(u) D_P^dagger has exact entries O_{P, u}[x, y] = (-1)^{P(x) XOR P(x XOR u)} 1[y == x XOR u], row degree 1, and directional derivative degree deg_{F_2}(Delta_u P) <= max(0, d - 1).

On w = 2^{t-1} variables, the MSB carry indicator C_{t-1}(x) = binom(wt_H(x), 2^{t-1}) mod 2 has exact F_2-algebraic degree 2^{t-1} (full-product ANF monomial), so for every Boolean polynomial Q : F_2^w -> F_2 of degree < 2^{t-1} (including Delta_u P for deg(P) <= 2^{t-1}), the top-degree ANF coefficient of Q(x) XOR C_{t-1}(x) is 1 != 0 and sum_{x in {0,1}^w} Q(x) mod 2 == 0.

For any M_terms label-independent IQP strings (P_j, u_j) with weights |w_j| <= 1, E_A[|Adv(O; A)|] <= (1/2) sum_j |w_j| v^{wt_H(u_j)} 2^{-nt} <= M_terms / (2 * 2^{nt}) even on a clean source (v=1). For label-adaptive (P_j, u_j) with ||O||_op <= 1, O has row degree D <= M_terms and obeys |Adv(O; A)| <= min(1/2, sqrt(M_terms) v^{w_min(A)} / 2).
